title: Rename speakers and session title; re-run speaker detection
description: Let the user replace "Speaker N" with real names, rename the session, and re-run diarization (goal 2).
steps: In `SessionRepository` add `renameSpeaker(sessionId, speakerIndex, label)` (trimmed; blank → ignored) and `renameSession(sessionId, title)` (trimmed; blank → ignored; max 100 chars).
In `SessionViewModel` add `fun renameSpeaker(index: Int, label: String)`, `fun renameSession(title: String)`.

In `SessionScreen`: tapping a speaker label in the transcript opens an `AlertDialog` with an `OutlinedTextField` prefilled with the current label, "Save"/"Cancel". A top-bar overflow menu (`Icons.Filled.MoreVert`) with items "Rename session" (same dialog pattern) and "Detect speakers again" which calls `ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, RecordingService.diarizeIntent(context, id))`; disable that item while status is DIARIZING or the session is RECORDING.
Show a row of `AssistChip`s above the transcript listing the session's speakers; tapping a chip opens the same rename dialog.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `renameSpeaker(0, "  Alice ")` makes lines with speakerIndex 0 show `Alice`
Test: blank label or title is ignored; title longer than 100 chars is truncated to 100
"Detect speakers again" menu item exists and sends `RecordingService.diarizeIntent` (visible in `SessionScreen.kt`)
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine. Only reference sherpa classes inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
